scope: Preserve verified genuine five-stage implementation evidence and clarify current role-specific report instructions without changing schemas or authority.
riskAnalysis: Prompt text is not authority. Exact source/task binding, schema/evidence validation, token/request/time limits, cancellation, no-tools policy and independent acceptance remain enforced server-side. New source fingerprint requires reviewed release qualification; consumed grants remain unusable.

threatModel.assets: Immutable model receipts, task/source/workspace identity, reviewer decisions and source-bound disposable patch evidence.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Model prose remains untrusted data; server schema, source binding, artifact validators and owner controller remain authoritative.
threatModel.abuseCases: Fabricated evidence, forged acceptance, instruction injection, rewriting reviewer rejection or conflating model output with backend actions.
threatModel.mitigations: No schema/permission change; exact references and source identity validation, empty tools, preserved criticism, original receipt hashes and current exact-release checks.

defects.rootCause: Generic evidence mapping instructions did not distinguish top-level report evidenceIds from schema-forbidden nested patch fields; later model reports conflated pre-application model statements with post-response trusted worker evidence.
defects.detectionGap: Fixture schemas passed, but the live Auditor demanded an impossible nested field and final Chief misunderstood application chronology. Several completed model strings ended at existing field ceilings; no backend clipping or token exhaustion was established.
defects.regression: All five role requests retain exact evidence contracts and reviewer criticism. Actual original receipt projections remain within existing byte bounds; real restricted offline five-stage fixtures, cancellation and cleanup pass. Historical compact/legacy request identities remain unchanged.
defects.historicalPrevention: Review instructions against each actual nested schema and supplied worker receipts. Use concise per-role guidance rather than copying all-role instructions into every stage; verify all five serialized requests before release.

rollback: Work may revert only the reviewed feature-branch prompt change if qualification fails; preserve original completed model receipts, failed test evidence, cleanup and financial history. No Production change or history rewrite.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Existing implementation parser adversarial checks remain unchanged; focused tests reject malformed and duplicated fields.
negativePaths.stale-state: Unchanged binding validators reject stale source, owner, workspace and copied model metadata in focused tests.
negativePaths.concurrency: Prompt-only function has no storage writes or concurrency behavior; existing authoritative CAS and serial controller remain unchanged.
negativePaths.cancellation: Independent actual offline worker tests verify cancellation and physical cleanup; no cancellation logic changed.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Existing restricted-child interruption and cleanup tests remain authoritative; no child permissions or process behavior changed.
negativePaths.api-outage: No provider transport or retry logic changed. An outage still fails the attempt closed and is never automatically retried.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Focused actual implementation tests retain source/owner/workspace/policy denials; prompt cannot create authority.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No financial controller change. Existing monitor-only historical policy and request/token/output limits remain authoritative.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Actual completed live receipts preserve stage outcomes; fixtures preserve Auditor rejection and unavailable dynamic verification without claiming acceptance.

proactiveReview.architecture: Only current role-specific instruction construction changes; existing adapter, schemas, controller and ledger are reused without new execution authority.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No packages, services, credentials, external systems or infrastructure were added or changed.
proactiveReview.threats: Untrusted prose may fabricate evidence, acceptance or execution; unchanged schema and source-binding validators remain authoritative.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Incomplete model prose remains criticizable. Audit rejection is copied honestly and no accepted implementation is fabricated.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Focused parser adversarial tests and real offline restricted-worker cancellation, malformed response and cleanup-failure fixtures passed.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate Work QA passed28checks and actual-native request bounds; Engineering Auditor passed15checks and verified all original live receipt hashes.
proactiveReview.recovery: All live authority revoked and frozen task canceled. Historical source and receipts preserved; a successor cannot inherit consumed grants.
proactiveReview.readiness: Focused tests and independent reviews passed. Existing remote CI/Redis/CodeQL/Jekyll/Preview checks must qualify the successor; no new paid attempt merely repeats milestone.
